name: study-sites
description: Cloneable study-site system: swap the material, keep the engine.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:browser
scripts.check: npm test && npm run check:static && npm run check:demo
scripts.check:static: node tools/gen-icons.mjs --check && node tools/lint-css.mjs && node tools/check-doc.mjs && node tools/build-agent-kit.mjs --check
scripts.check:demo: node tools/validate.mjs --isolated demo && node tools/gen-materials.mjs --check demo && node tools/audit-content.mjs demo
scripts.author: node tools/author.mjs
scripts.backend:init: npx wrangler d1 execute learn-sync --remote --file tools/schema.sql
scripts.backend:secret: npx wrangler pages secret put SYNC_SECRET
